story-context.summary: Implement an offline-first submission pipeline for public token-based forms: validate client-side, submit immediately when online, queue in IndexedDB when offline, and auto-sync when connectivity returns.
story-context.problem-statement: Event environments have unreliable WiFi/cellular. Losing connectivity currently means losing leads. Story 3.11 introduces an Outbox queue so submissions are captured reliably offline and synced when online.

key-features.feature: Public submission endpoint (token-gated) with minimal DB persistence
Public outbox queue stored in IndexedDB (offline-first)
Auto-sync on reconnect with bounded retries and clear status transitions
Public UX feedback: queued/ syncing/ uploaded + pending count indicator
Idempotency key support (client + server) to prevent duplicates on retry
Client context capture (clientDeviceId + timezone/locale + UA) for device-level diagnostics
Shared-device safety: reset/clear form values after submit/queue to prevent data leakage
Validation-blocked attempt telemetry (rule + component IDs, no raw values)

reference-documents.document: Public renderer baseline (submission transport deferred to Story 3.11)
Agent logging reference for evidence capture and troubleshooting

key-types.type: IndexedDB-stored outbox record with status + retry metadata
Server-side persistence record. Stores AnswerJSON (NVARCHAR(MAX) JSON) keyed by componentId and references FormVersionID for interpretation.

key-files.file: Replace submission-deferred behavior with Outbox submission (online submit + offline queue)
Surface public submission status (pending count / syncing indicator) if required
Public outbox queue implementation (IndexedDB store, enqueue, processQueue, retry policy)
API client for submitting token-scoped payloads to backend
Pydantic schemas for public submission request/response
Minimal submission persistence model (JSON payload + metadata + idempotency key)
Migration to create submission persistence table (human executes migration commands)

done-criteria.criterion: Online submission succeeds end-to-end (UI → API → DB persist)
Offline submission queues to IndexedDB and survives reload
Queued submissions auto-sync on reconnect with clear status transitions
Basic idempotency prevents duplicates on retry

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Online submissions are persisted in a DB table (e.g., dbo.FormSubmission) with AnswersJSON
Offline submissions are queued locally and later synced successfully
Token validation enforced on submission endpoint
Each persisted submission includes a clientDeviceId and minimal client context (privacy-safe; no fingerprinting)
After a submission is queued or uploaded, the form values are cleared for the next attendee (shared-device safety)
Validation failures generate telemetry for analysis without persisting raw field values (include type/length/shape diagnostics)

forbidden-zones.zone: No back-office review/analytics workflows (explicitly out of scope for Story 3.11)
Do not require authentication for public form submission (must remain token-gated and auth-free)
Do not introduce schema-breaking changes to FormVersion.DefinitionJSON
Do not persist partial/invalid responses with raw PII without explicit product decision and retention policy

risks.risk: Public forms are auth-free; queue/persistence must not depend on authenticated user state.
Idempotency and retry behavior must be correct to prevent duplicate submissions during flaky connectivity.
IndexedDB behavior differences across browsers (mitigate by deterministic API + simple store design).
